none: PAS CAM-0880D7: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, holding standard and dragging captive. Mint is Siscia, AD 367-375. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legedn reads (D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG). Reverse fields and exergue read: [...]?/-A//[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12…
